edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the 'from' address via _msgSender()
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing allowance
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before sending ETH
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() to gate privileged functions
block.timestamp determines cooldown[to] and gates buys with require(cooldown[to] < block.timestamp)
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp is used as the deadline for addLiquidityETH in openTrading
onlyOwner guards the openTrading bootstrap function
onlyOwner guards setBots which can block arbitrary addresses
onlyOwner guards delBot
onlyOwner guards the cooldown toggle
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for its authorization check
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after swapping
_transfer delegates the actual balance updates to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to], reading the bot blacklist
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee/cooldown treatment
_transfer enforces require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) for pair buys
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address
_transfer compares counterparties against the uniswapV2Router address
_transfer checks the inSwap lock flag before swapping
_transfer checks swapEnabled before performing the automatic swap
_transfer checks cooldownEnabled before applying the cooldown branch
_transfer writes cooldown[to] after a qualifying buy from the pair
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call with amountOutMin 0 while contract state is live
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to external fee wallets from within the transfer path
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with value equal to the entire contract balance
openTrading calls the Uniswap factory createPair to obtain the pair address
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve which writes _allowances
_transferStandard subtracts from _rOwned[sender] and adds to _rOwned[recipient]
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the computed team amount
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the computed fee values
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the scaled team amount
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal
_getValues calls _getTValues to obtain token fee and team splits
_getValues calls _getRValues to obtain reflection amounts
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate
_getTValues computes tAmount.mul(taxFee).div(100) and tAmount.sub(tFee).sub(tTeam), a rounding-sensitive arithmetic path
_getRValues scales amounts by currentRate with mul/sub, propagating rounding and overflow risk
_feeAddr1 supplies the tax percentage used by _getTValues
_feeAddr2 supplies the team percentage used by _getTValues
balanceOf converts a reflection balance via tokenFromReflection
tokenFromReflection reads _rOwned[account] to compute the token balance
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned by _getRate
_getRate obtains rSupply/tSupply from _getCurrentSupply
_getRate divides _rTotal by _tTotal in its guard expression
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply source
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the caller's allowance
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract token balance
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2
manualswap compares the caller against the _feeAddrWallet1 state variable
manualsend compares the caller against the _feeAddrWallet1 state variable
swapTokensForEth queries the router for WETH and executes the swap on it
openTrading assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router
openTrading stores the pair returned by the factory into uniswapV2Pair
The external router swap can call back into the token (pair callbacks) while _transfer is mid-execution; lockTheSwap mitigates but the pair is untrusted
ETH transfer to a fee wallet is executed inside _transfer before _tokenTransfer completes, so a contract fee wallet could re-enter
addLiquidityETH is invoked with the whole contract balance before tradingOpen/swapEnabled are finalized, allowing state to be observed mid-execution

normalization_plan.reason: 'from' is only meaningful as the source operand of the _transfer state/mapping updates
'to' is only meaningful as the destination operand of the _transfer state/mapping updates
'amount' is only used for the max-tx and bot/cooldown checks inside _transfer
'sender' is the address whose _rOwned entry is debited in _transferStandard
'recipient' is the address whose _rOwned entry is credited in _transferStandard
'tAmount' is the input decomposed by _getValues during _transferStandard
'bots_' is the owner-supplied array iterated to write the bots blacklist
'notbot' is the single address cleared in the bots mapping by delBot
'spender' is the allowance key written by _approve from approve
'tokenAmount' is the amount approved and swapped in the router call
'amount' is the ETH value split between the two fee wallets
'rAmount' is the reflection input divided by the current rate
'tAmount' is the input scaled into t-values and r-values
'account' is the key read from _rOwned before conversion
Temporary balance snapshot used to trigger the swap inside _transfer
Temporary rate value that is the direct output of _getRate used for scaling
